sentences.en: Two tickets for the seven o'clock show, please.
I heard the tickets sold out within an hour.
sentences.ko: 표가 한 시간 만에 매진됐다고 들었어.

sentences.en: Could we get seats in the back row?
I'm sorry you're going through such a tough time.
sentences.ko: 네가 그렇게 힘든 시간을 보내고 있다니 마음이 아파.

sentences.en: If you ever need to talk, I'm all ears.
sentences.ko: 언제든 이야기하고 싶으면 말해, 잘 들어줄게.
